scripts.use:render: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='.env.local';let s=fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const line='NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://artime-backend.onrender.com';if(s.match(/^NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=.*$/m)) s=s.replace(/^NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=.*$/m,line); else s=line+'\n'+s;fs.writeFileSync(p,s);console.log('Set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to Render');"
scripts.use:local: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='.env.local';let s=fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const line='NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000';if(s.match(/^NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=.*$/m)) s=s.replace(/^NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=.*$/m,line); else s=line+'\n'+s;fs.writeFileSync(p,s);console.log('Set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to Local');"
